################################################################################
Purpose of script: Check climate and school data and create covars df for the 
SE2I2R model (Colombia)
Output:
- df_covars (covariate for the SE2I2R model)
################################################################################

# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(glue)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(pomp)

source("fun_createSE2I2Rmod.R")
theme_set(theme_classic())
```

```{r}
fun_reformatsimulations <- function(sims_wide, delta_t = delta_t) {
  # Args: 
  # sims_wide: simulations in wide format (data frame)
  # Returns: simulations in long format, with year and week no added
  
  sims_long <- sims_wide %>% 
    mutate(E = E1 + E2, 
           I = I1 + I2, 
           week = (time - delta_t / 2) %% 52 + delta_t / 2,
           year = (time - delta_t / 2) %/% 52 + 1) %>% 
    select(time, everything(), -c("E1", "E2", "I1", "I2")) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(.id, time, year, week), 
                 names_to = "state_var", 
                 values_to = "val")
  
  # Check that all years and weeks appear the same no of time 
  stopifnot(length(unique(table(sims_long$year))) == 1)
  
  return(sims_long)
}
```

# Read in and plot school and climate data 
```{r}
# School terms
dat_school <- readRDS("data_school_calendar.rds") %>%
  filter(country == "colombia") %>%
  mutate(school = case_when(school == 0 ~ -1, .default = school))

# Climatic variables 
dat_clim <- readRDS(glue("data_clim_sel_week_nc_col.rds")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("w_"), names_to = "clim_var") %>% 
  mutate(week = str_remove(week, pattern = "week_"),
         week = as.integer(week)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  # Summarise per year
  group_by(clim_var, mun_cod, mun_name, mun_latitude, mun_longitude, week) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Standardize 
  group_by(clim_var, mun_cod, mun_name) %>%
  mutate(value_stand = scale(value)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot data school calendar
ggplot(dat_school, 
       aes(x = as.numeric(week), y = school, color = country)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point()

# Plot data climate
ggplot(filter(dat_clim, clim_var == "w_hum_spe"),
       aes(x = week, y = value_stand)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~ reorder(mun_name, -mun_latitude), scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_viridis_c() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") 
```

```{r}
# 1. Prepare covars 
covars <- data.frame(week = rep(1:52, 200), time = 1:(52*200)) %>%
  left_join(filter(dat_clim, mun_name == "BOGOTA", clim_var == "w_hum_spe") %>%
              select(week, value_stand) %>%
              rename(AH = value_stand), by = join_by(week)) %>%
  left_join(filter(dat_clim, mun_name == "BOGOTA", clim_var == "w_temp_mean") %>%
              select(week, value_stand) %>%
              rename(Te = value_stand), by = join_by(week)) %>%
  select(-week)

# 2. Create pomp object and make basic checks
mod <- fun_createSE2I2Rmod(n_years = 200, country_name = "Colombia", covars = covars, 
                           amp_term = 0.25, e_AH = -0.04, e_Te = 0, dt = 0.1, prot0 = 0.9, amp_prot = 0.3,
                           debug_bool = F)

# 3. Run 1 simulation
tj <- trajectory(object = mod, format = "data.frame", method = "lsoda")
stopifnot(round(rowSums(select(tj, c("V", "S", "E1", "E2", "I1", "I2", "R"))), digits = 3) == 1)
fun_reformatsimulations(tj, delta_t = 0.1) %>%
  mutate(state_var = factor(state_var, levels = c("V", "S", "E", "I", "R", "CC"))) %>%
  filter(year > 190) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = val)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(state_var~., scales = "free")

# 4. Run different simulations 
# Define grid of parameters to change
chg_parms <- expand.grid(
  prot0 = c(0, 0.90),
  #amp_prot = c(0, 0.2, 0.4),
  #phi_prot = c(5, 17.83, 25, 35, 47.5)
  amp_prot = c(0, 0.8),
  phi_prot = c(17.83),
  amp_term = c(0, 0.25)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(.id = as.character(seq_len(nrow(.))))
# Create mat of parameters with changes 
p_mat <- parmat(params = coef(mod), nrep = nrow(chg_parms))
p_mat["prot0", ] <- chg_parms$prot0
p_mat["amp_prot", ] <- chg_parms$amp_prot
p_mat["phi_prot", ] <- chg_parms$phi_prot
p_mat["amp_term", ] <- chg_parms$amp_term

tjm <- trajectory(object = mod, format = "data.frame", method = "lsoda", params = p_mat)

tjm %>%
  mutate(N = round(V + S + E1 + E2 + I1 + I2 + R, digits = 3),
         VR = R+V) %>%
  fun_reformatsimulations(delta_t = 0.1) %>%
  filter(year > 195) %>%
  left_join(chg_parms) %>%
  #filter(phi_prot == 25) %>%
  filter(prot0 == 0.90) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time/52, y = val, color = amp_prot, group = amp_prot)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(state_var~amp_term, scales = "free", ncol = 2)

```



```{r}
week = 1:52
omega = 2.0 * pi / 52.0
prot0 = 1
#amp_prot = 0.5
a1 = 0.26
b1 = -0.16 

A = 0.3
phi = 47.5
prot_seas = a1 * cos(omega * week) + b1 * sin(omega * week)
prot_t = prot0 * (1.0 + prot_seas)
prot_seas2 = A*cos(omega * (week - phi))
prot_t2 = prot0 * (1.0 + prot_seas2)

prot_seas3 = A*cos((omega * week) - (phi * omega))
prot_t3 = prot0 * (1.0 + prot_seas2)

data.frame(week, prot_t, prot_t3) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = prot_t)) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_line(aes(y = prot_t3), color = "red") +
  geom_line(aes(y = prot_t3), color = "red")


```
